## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] Regression coverage added for behavior changes, or explain why unnecessary.
- [ ] Documentation updated if the interface or setup changes.

Note checks that were not run and why. Do not include real credentials or email content.

## Compatibility and security

Describe changes to account storage, permissions, provider requests, or public tool schemas, if any. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.
